summary: Verified full APK PRINT_RECEIPT data payload (iter73). Backend GET /api/kiosk/payments/{id}/print-data: 401 without kiosk session, 404 for unknown id, 200 returns exactly the required 13 keys {bedrijfsnaam, adres, telefoon, kwitantie, datum, naam, appartement, vestiging, omschrijving, bedrag, openstaand, methode, opmerking} with datum in DD-MM-YYYY HH:MM format and bedrag/openstaand prefixed 'SRD '. Frontend E2E in APK mock: injected window.ReactNativeWebView.postMessage, kiosk PIN 4321 → Filiaal — Nieuw Nickerie → Studio 1 → amount SRD 1.000,00 → Contant → confirm. Exactly ONE PRINT_RECEIPT message after confirm {type:'PRINT_RECEIPT', url:'.../print.html?format=thermal&preview=1', data:{...13 keys}} with values matching the ReceiptScreen (KW2026-00548, Kevin Doelahasori, Studio 1, SRD 1.000,00, Contant, 11-10-2026 19:49, SuriRent N.V., 'Filiaal — Nieuw Nickerie', 'Vooruitbetaling — November 2026', openstaand SRD 3.500,00, opmerking 'Vooruitbetaling voor november 2026'). Clicking 'Print bon opnieuw' emits a 2nd PRINT_RECEIPT with 14 keys (same 13 + payment_id) and identical values. 3/3 pytest pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Observation: in this seeded tenant/location (Filiaal — Nieuw Nickerie), the location record has no phone, so data.telefoon came back as an empty string. The backend fallback chain is (location.phone || payment.company_phone || payment.company_whatsapp) — correct — but if the main agent wants a non-empty telefoon on the APK bon it should ensure company admin profile phone is seeded, OR add 'company_whatsapp' lookup from companies collection as another fallback (currently only read from the already-enriched payment doc).

sendApkPrint in KioskLayout.jsx:2395 does an extra GET /kiosk/payments/{id}/print-data after submit, while lib/kiosk-print.js's APK branch does the same on reprint. The confirm path currently merges the local {naam, appartement, bedrag, methode, datum, kwitantie} with the backend data via spread {...data, ...full}, which means backend values win — good (keeps formatting consistent). But if print-data fails (network), the user still gets a partial 6-key payload instead of the required 13. Suggest adding a user-visible warning or falling back to a direct re-fetch of a cached receipt view.
The console.log('[APK PRINT_RECEIPT]', msg) fires BEFORE the ReactNativeWebView check — leftover noise in web mode (pre-existing from iter71/72).
